name: Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
summary: Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi operates in the cement industry in Turkey and internationally. It operates through Products based on Stone and Soil; Ready-mixed Concrete; Port Services; and Electricity Production segments. The company offers cement clinkers and potassium silicate cements; sulphate resistant, compound, and pozzolanic cements; and aggregate and cement bypass dust products. It is also involved in port operations; gravel and sand quarrying; and the production and sale of electricity. Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Izmir, Turkey.
